experience.recentNotice: Search retained segments in the current administrator scope. Counts are stored rows, not unique users or actions; last receipt is not a global causal order.
experience.recentUserHelp: Use the exact verified user ID, not a username. Leave blank for this scope.
experience.recentPartial: Partial retained observations. The window, row limit or missing metadata may omit segments; no complete activity history is claimed.
experience.recentEmpty: No retained segments match these filters. This does not prove that no activity occurred.
experience.recentIdle: No automatic lookup. Choose filters and explicitly find recent segments. Anonymous inclusion uses the explicit choice below and requires unscoped server approval.
experience.recentSelected: Support code selected below. Choose Find exact records to read its timeline; no operation was replayed.
experience.title: Semantic experience trace
experience.uuidHelp: Enter the full lowercase UUID retained in the record. Paths and usernames are not search keys.
experience.optional: Optional · leave empty for the whole segment
experience.anonymousHelp: The server rechecks unscoped access, anonymous-read configuration and current global administrator authority. This choice grants no permission.
experience.exportNotice: Explicit export freshly queries up to 2,000 records with the same filters and writes an audit record. It never executes the original operation.
experience.denied: Current verified administrator authority is required, or this scope does not permit the query.
experience.stale: Filters or authority scope changed. Previous results were cleared; search again explicitly.
experience.unavailable: Experience tracing is disabled or unsupported by this server.
experience.sqlError: The diagnostic store or query audit is unavailable. This is not an empty result. Try the query later.
experience.failed: The query failed. Check the filters and search again.
experience.exportFailed: Export did not complete. Check current authority and store availability before trying again.
experience.exportComplete: A read-only JSON download was requested. It contains retained observations, not proof of a complete experience.
experience.partial: Partial observations · subsequent screen state unknown
experience.coverageNotice: Browser reports, server requests and recorded worker outcomes are separate. Accepted is not ready; cancellation requested is not confirmed termination. Remote internals and missing screen tails are unknown. State application, render commit and exposure differ and never prove human reading. No DOM or screenshot is reconstructed.
experience.orderNotice: Records follow storage-page order. Receive time and database IDs are not a global causal order. Client sequence and monotonic time apply only within their segment; device clocks may skew. Cause references are observed links, not proof.
experience.empty: No retained records match this scope and these exact identifiers. This does not prove that no operation occurred.
experience.idle: Enter an exact segment ID, then search. There is no automatic query or original API replay.
experience.committed: Render commit observed · not DOM reconstruction
experience.exposure: Screen exposure observed · not proof of reading
experience.messageUnavailable: No retained static text exists for this revision and language. Today's translation is not substituted.
experience.causeUnavailable: Cause reference unavailable in this scope or page
experience.notice: Only bounded semantic events are linked, not inputs, DOM or video. Browser reports do not prove server verification or actual resource readiness.
events.timelineNotice: Up to 50 events in the selected scope and period. Client-declared correlation is not proof of causality; an observation is not business success.
events.noTimeline: No correlated events match this source.
events.localDelivery: This tab’s best-effort buffer: queued {queued}, delivered {sent}, dropped {dropped}, failed batches {failed}. Not server-wide or lossless; scope changes discard pending observations.

overview.capacity.nova: Nova hypervisor counters · not guest utilization
overview.capacity.cpuSource: Allocated vCPU: Nova vcpus_used. Inventory CPUs: Placement VCPU total, not verified physical cores. Configured capacity: sum(total × allocation_ratio), before reservations; not an enforced policy ceiling. Ratios above 100% can be normal overcommit, not a fault.
overview.capacity.memorySource: Memory is Nova memory_mb_used / memory_mb, divided by 1024 (GiB); not a measured guest-memory percentage.
overview.capacity.storageSource: Storage adds Cinder provisioned volume GiB and active Glance image bytes / 2³⁰, compared with Cinder pool capacity. It is not physical disk usage; images may use other backends and shared pools can overlap.
overview.capacity.collectionSource: Timestamp is collection time (the response may be cached), not a native sample time. Failed sources stay unavailable; a successfully read empty inventory is zero.
